decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient creatures and burn spells, backed up by the card advantage and damage potential provided by Showdown of the Skalds. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of flexibility to the deck. By combining aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bonecrusher Giant with powerful burn spells like Play with Fire and Chained to the Rocks, this Boros Aggro deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by countering opponent's spells, utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, and generating card advantage with cards like Memory Deluge. The deck also includes win conditions like Shark Typhoon and The Wandering Emperor to finish off the opponent. It has a mana base that supports its control game plan with lands that provide utility like Castle Ardenvale and Field of Ruin. Overall, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while establishing its own dominant board presence.

The main concept of this Izzet Control deck is to control the game through a combination of removal spells, counter spells, and card draw. By using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Blitz of the Thunder-Raptor to control the board, along with counters like Spell Pierce, the deck aims to stall the opponent's game plan while setting up for a big finish with Crackling Drake. The deck also utilizes Treasure Cruise to refill its hand and maintain card advantage. The mana base is designed to support both early game plays and late game threats.

The deck focuses on using Lotus Field along with a variety of untap effects and ramp spells to quickly generate a large amount of mana. This allows the player to cast powerful spells like Omniscience, Emergent Ultimatum, and Bala Ged Recovery to dominate the game. The deck also includes ways to dig through the deck for key combo pieces and protect its important spells with counterspells. Overall, the strategy revolves around assembling the necessary components to execute a game-winning combo as efficiently as possible.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to control the board and deal damage to the opponent. It leverages cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven to create a powerful engine that generates value through sacrificing creatures. Additionally, Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute are used to steal the opponent's creatures and sacrifice them for benefit. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bloodtithe Harvester to close out games quickly.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice effects to generate value and control the board while also applying pressure on the opponent. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and using cards like Mayhem Devil, the deck aims to deal damage to the opponent's creatures and potentially finish them off with direct damage. The inclusion of Claim the Firstborn allows for stealing key creatures from the opponent and sacrificing them for additional value. This aggressive strategy is further supported by efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and disruption like Thoughseize.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on quickly sacrificing creatures for value, triggering effects like Mayhem Devil and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal damage to the opponent. It utilizes cards like Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to repeatedly sacrifice creatures, generating advantage and disrupting the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to control the board and protect your threats. The addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and consistency to the deck's game plan.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly and aggressively overwhelm your opponent with a combination of creatures and burn spells. The deck utilizes efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Bonecrusher Giant along with burn spells like Play with Fire and Chained to the Rocks to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. The inclusion of the companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional element of consistency to the deck. The strategy is to establish an early board presence and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It aims to outvalue the opponent by using cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge to generate card advantage, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Dovin's Veto and Field of Ruin. The deck can also create threats with Shark Typhoon and Hall of Storm Giants, while utilizing Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion to provide additional value and card advantage through its enter the battlefield effect.

The main idea of this Azorius Tempo / Spirit Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly with evasive creatures like Spectral Sailor and Shacklegeist, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Spell Queller and Lofty Denial. Curious Obsession helps draw cards to maintain momentum, while Supreme Phantom pumps up the team. Mutavault provides additional threats, and the mana base is tailored to support the aggressive strategy. Overall, the deck aims to establish an early board presence and apply constant pressure to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck revolves around the idea of dealing fast and consistent damage to the opponent through aggressive plays and burn spells. It focuses on building a board presence with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Bonecrusher Giant while also using direct damage spells like Play with Fire and Kumano Faces Kakkazan to finish off the opponent quickly. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility to the deck. Overall, this Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless assault of damage.

The deck focuses on generating and utilizing a high amount of green mana to power out powerful creatures and spells quickly, overwhelming the opponent with aggression. By utilizing cards that generate extra mana such as Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Llanowar Elves, as well as cards that benefit from having a high devotion to green like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, the deck aims to play large threats early in the game and maintain pressure throughout. The deck also includes cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival to further enhance its aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on flooding the battlefield with low-cost, efficient creatures that can quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing abilities like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, along with cards like Brave the Elements for protection and Castle Ardenvale for additional tokens, the goal is to maintain a strong board presence and apply consistent pressure. With a mix of creatures that provide buffs, protection, and additional token generation, this deck aims to establish dominance early in the game and maintain it until the opponent is overwhelmed.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, allowing for explosive plays with high-devotion green cards such as Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Karn, the Great Creator is used to search for key artifacts, while Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner provides card draw and ramp. Storm the Festival helps to refill the board quickly with powerful creatures, and Boseiju, Who Endures protects key spells. Lair of the Hydra provides a strong mana sink, while Cityscape Leveler can provide a game-winning alternate win condition.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly to play Lotus Field and combo pieces to generate a massive amount of mana and card advantage. Using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Thespian's Stage to find Lotus Field, and Hidden Strings to untap it, the deck aims to cast powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and win the game through a strong board presence and card advantage. The deck also includes support cards like Bala Ged Recovery and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to further enhance its combo potential.

This Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrificing mechanics to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. The deck includes cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, Claim the Firstborn, and Witch's Oven to generate value from sacrificing creatures. It also includes cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Deadly Dispute for disruption and removal. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays while maintaining a strong board presence and controlling the game through sacrificing creatures.
